facts.fact: Paratus Tanzania says its new Dar es Salaam PoP gives Tanzania access to Paratus-owned network routes north to Nairobi via Mombasa and south to Maputo, with direct international connectivity to Europe and the US.
facts.system: Paratus Tanzania Dar es Salaam PoP

facts.fact: Paratus Tanzania says the PoP lets it provide IP transit, Layer 2 circuits and wholesale network capacity to local carriers, ISPs and enterprises.
